title: Lemosse 1998 costovertebral joint torsion total range of motion (intact)

source.authors: Lemosse D, Le Rue O, Diop A, Skalli W, Marec P, Lavaste F
source.sample: costovertebral functional units (2 vertebrae + rib, first 12 cm of rib) at T1-T2-R2, T5-T6-R6, T9-T10-R10 from 9 fresh cadaveric thoracic cages (bilateral; n per cell 3-14)
source.sex: 10 M, 1 F (as printed for donor table)

protocol.summary: Units sterilised (2.5 Mrad beta) and frozen -30 C; vertebrae fixed; light loading disc (109 g) on the rib; mass-pulley moments from +0.6 to -0.6 Nm and back in 0.1 Nm steps about the rib neck axis (torsion), cranial/caudal flexion (Z) and ventral/dorsal flexion (Y); 3-D motion by optoelectronics (Vicon). TRM = range between -0.6 and +0.6 Nm; MLS = motion between -0.1 and +0.1 Nm (low-stiffness zone); PLZ/NLZ = flexibility (deg/Nm) of quasi-linear zones 0.2-0.6 Nm and -0.2 to -0.6 Nm. Lesions: 0 intact, 1 superior costotransverse ligament cut, 2 + lateral, 3 + interosseous.
how_to_simulate: Fix both vertebrae of the costovertebral unit; keep 12 cm of rib
Apply pure moments up to +-0.6 Nm about the rib neck axis (torsion), cranial-caudal and ventral-dorsal axes in 0.1 Nm steps
Report rib rotation range (TRM, MLS) and flexibility in the 0.2-0.6 Nm zones

extraction.check_notes: Tables 2-4 from text layer, columns aligned (Average, SD per parameter, n). doi not printed. Lesion rows: costotransverse ligaments sectioned successively.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
